Work package F (S2, 'reviews never stall'), tools/scope-loop.mjs only (+ its tests). Real failure from the roadmap ledger history: wave 6 failed at review start on a bad path ('lessons/swarm', a directory), and the loop then reported 'stuck: skeleton not finished' with 10 tickets in review and no review ever running. Fix: (1) at loop start and on resume, every ticket with status 'review' that has no recorded review run (no entry in the loop's review record for that ticket/wave; read how scope-loop records reviews around deps.review and deps.record...) gets its acceptance review queued through the existing deps.review path; (2) a review that fails to START (deps.review throws before running) raises a NAMED blocker instead of a silent 'stuck': use the loop's existing blocker/journal mechanism (read how scope-loop raises blockers / writes journal events; reuse it) with id 'review-start-<ticket or wave id>' and text '<ticket id>: review could not start: <reason> (path <path> if the error names one)'; the loop status becomes 'stuck' with reason naming the blocker id, never 'skeleton not finished' when tickets are in review; (3) saved review manifests (.swarm/*-reviews/*.json) are regenerated from the CURRENT ticket context each time a review starts, never reused with old paths. Do NOT touch tools/swarm.mjs or the tools/swarm folder. Tests: tests/scope-loop-review-stall.test.mjs (node:test, injected deps: fake review/record/journal, fixed clock): 10 tickets in review without review runs get 10 (or one batched) review starts on resume; a review whose start throws with a path in the message yields a blocker with that id/text and status stuck with that reason; a stale saved manifest with an old path is rewritten from current ticket context before review.
